## Summary

- **Why a weather question toasted "云端尚未升级，手机日历读取暂不可用":** `digitalmateClientContext()` puts `calendar_read: true` on *every* request regardless of topic, so an old cloud (which does not know the field) rejects even "今天天气" with `BAD_PARAMS: Extra inputs are not permitted [client.calendar_read]`. The client's retry path then shows a calendar-specific toast — once per message, on every message.
- `drainSend` now records the rejection in an in-memory `calendarReadUnsupported` flag, and a new `outgoingClientContext()` helper drops `calendar_read` from all later sends. Unrelated questions stop paying the retry round-trip and the misleading toast.

## Design choice

This mirrors the existing `profilingEnabled` suppression (same `BAD_PARAMS` shape), but is **deliberately not persisted**: once the cloud upgrades, the next app start re-advertises `calendar_read`, whereas the persisted profiling flag never comes back on its own. A comment in `Index.ets` records this reasoning.

## Changes

- `Index.ets`: `calendarReadUnsupported` field (page lifetime), `outgoingClientContext()` helper, both frame-construction sites (`task.create`, `room.message`) route through it, and the calendar rejection branch sets the flag before toasting.
- `tests/unit/digitalmate-composer-send.test.mjs`: new regression test — after the first rejection + successful safe retry, a second send ("今天天气") goes out with no `calendar_read`, exactly one request, and no additional toast. All 79 tests in the file pass.
- ST contract: the composer slice gains a fourth method, so `extractComposer` in `tests/st/prepare.mjs`, the ST host (`ComposerHost.ets`: new field + `DigitalMateClientContext` type import), and the two vm-sliced extraction tests are updated to the new shape. The fail-closed guard still throws on any further structural drift.

## Test plan

- `node --test tests/unit/digitalmate-composer-send.test.mjs` — 79/79 pass.
- `node --test "tests/unit/*.test.mjs"` (glob form) — 3070 tests: 3061 pass, 0 fail, 9 skipped (pre-existing opt-in skips).
- Before the ST-contract update the full suite showed exactly 14 failures (6 in `digitalmate-message-actions`, 8 ST files), all traced to the extraction guard tripping on the new method — not pre-existing flakiness; all 14 pass after the contract update.

## Summary

HIVE-MEMORY ([#1312](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1312)) for Project Hive Phase 3, gate G5 ([#1316](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1316), design [#1228](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228)). This adds the `temp/hive-memory` transition feature (package `dm_hive_memory`).

**Stacked on HIVE1.** The branch is cut from `hive/hive1-integration` at `c2b995e1`. It needs #1268's migration port and driver and #1311's ledger, which land through [#1336](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1336). Until #1336 merges, this diff against main also shows the HIVE1 commits. Only the last commit, `2cc02929`, belongs to this PR. It is a draft and must not be merged before #1336.

### What it does
- **Global Memory provider** (`ingestion/provider.py`) implements #1268's `MemoryIngestion`:
  - Ingesting the same `migration_id` twice publishes once.
  - A lost ACK is answered by `query` on the original ID.
  - Different material under one ID is refused.
  - Sealed bytes are copied at acceptance and checked against the listing.
  - Publication is delayed and happens exactly once.
  - Ingestion that finishes after the Bee was revived still works, and its progress stays queryable by `migration_id`.
  - Revoked fragments are never readable: revocations are re-checked at publication and again at read time, and a revocation also applies to material that arrives later. A scope reset forgets everything before it.
  - Each scope (account) only sees its own memory.
  - The provider owns its own SQLite file (`hm_*` tables) and is the single writer of Hive Global Memory. Legacy EngineMemory keeps production writes until the M22/M38 switch-over (#999's "now" phase).
- **History and classification backfill** (`backfill/runner.py`) runs the way v0.1.10 `HistoryArchive` did:
  - one identity and high water per scope; a repeated upgrade resumes it;
  - batches of at most 8;
  - rules and citations first, with a model judge (bounded budget and timeout) for ambiguous turns;
  - each turn is re-read from its owner before ingest; hidden, forgotten or deleted turns are skipped; in-flight and post-cutoff turns are deferred to the live path;
  - an interrupted batch resumes as the original batch and never publishes twice;
  - the backfill is silent (`historical`) and never re-runs old tasks;
  - progress lives in its own file (`hb_*` tables).
- **Candidate taxonomy** (`config/taxonomy.toml`): PPMA's ten classes, plus mappings from the legacy MemoryEntry kinds and the EngineMemory catalog kinds. It is **not frozen**, and `structured_publication = false` until the #999 Memory owner signs it. All tunables are in TOML.
- **Temporary read-only legacy adapter** (`server_engine/hive_memory_history.py`) reads the old workspace store as a `HistorySource`. H-R3/#1313 replaces it with the History/Session Store owner's versioned reader.
- **Contract proposal:** fragment ingestion, retrieval, revoke and reset are provider-internal for now. `temp/hive-memory/docs/proposal-memory-contract.md` is the proposal for the #999 owner, with four open questions.

### Scenario and CI wiring
- **SC05-M1 to M5** are registered in the Hive runner (`tests/scenarios/hive/sc05.py`, `assertions.toml`, `producers.toml`), and `run_hive.py` now accepts `--gate G5`.
- **`memory_provider` is now a real producer.** SC01-W6 loads it when it probes real. Otherwise it falls back to #1268's labelled controlled provider, and the report names whichever one ran.
- **CI and packaging:** a `hive-memory` CI suite (44 tests), the Bridge wheel `force-include`, and the installed-package proof rows.
- **Architecture test fixture:** `copy_transition_sources` now also copies the transition features that a copied feature names in `allowed`, transitively. hive-memory depends on hive-worker's published exports, which the real gate already accepts.

## Verification (head `2cc02929`, base `hive/hive1-integration@c2b995e1`)

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `temp/hive-memory/tests` (unittest discover) | 44 passed |
| `python3.13 tools/architecture/check.py --policy docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json --root .` | exit 0, 0 findings, 181/426 files checked, `hive-memory` admitted (4 components + 1 adapter) |
| `tests/architecture` | 236 run, 3 failures, the same 3 `test_domains` failures as `origin/main` (composio-mail / report-goals dynamic SQL). Because the fixture now copies hive-worker, those 3 failures also list 6 existing hive-worker dynamic-SQL sites (owner #1268). hive-memory has no findings. |
| `run_hive.py --gate G5 --ids SC05-M1..M5 --source checkout --skip-package-proof` | M1 PASS · M2 **BLOCKED** · M3 PASS · M4 PASS · M5 PASS |
| `run_hive.py --gate G1 --ids SC01-W6 --source checkout --skip-package-proof` | PASS with `memory_provider=real` |
| `tests/scenarios` `test_hive_runner`, `test_hive_admission_steps` | OK |
| Local Bridge wheel build | `dm_hive_memory` and its three TOML files are inside and byte-identical; the settings load from the installed copy |

**Real participants:** the provider; the backfill runner; the legacy adapter over a real `EngineService`/`EngineStore` workspace; the Bridge `/digitalmate/ws` socket that the Mobile Gateway forwards to (M1, default and hosted-sessions modes); #1311's `SQLiteSessionRepository` migration ledger; #1268's migration driver, WorkSwarm factory and `SealedGenerationStore`.

**Substitutes (labelled in `temp/hive-memory/tests/hive_memory_support.py`):**
- `ScriptedHistory`: an in-memory history source, used for exact batch boundaries only.
- `ScriptedJudge`: a controlled model, which #1312 allows for M4.
- `LossySink` / `LossyIngestion`: a controlled transport in front of the real provider that loses the ACK after the commit.

- **SC05-M2 live relay: BLOCKED.** The History/Session Store durable-cursor contract (#1312 review item 2) has no sign-off. The `live_ingestion` row stays empty.

## Purpose

Add an explicit Worker-owned Phase 2 roster view for the selected new-ID-after-eviction policy. Active generation-one Bees are selectable; an archived Bee with a recorded generation is only a scoped profile reference. Missing or generation-zero bindings remain unverified, and retrying an initial start requires the original creation receipt and an authoritative B/Host verifier.

This is a read-only selection view, not an admission or activation authority. It does not change the Phase 1 H-D2 Store default, add a Store writer, alter dev E's Delivery work or enforce a new-ID lifecycle by itself. The Store owner must publish an authoritative lifecycle fact and atomically reject new activation/admission of evicted identities; the first-start verifier is a proposed interface pending owner agreement.

Phase 1's binding projection does not distinguish an H-D2 revival from a legitimate Session rotation for an active generation greater than one. This candidate fails closed on all such active bindings: that prevents selecting a revived identity but also blocks legitimate Session rotation. This is temporary, not the intended final policy; integration needs a B-owned lifecycle fact before enabling normal routing. Store binding, receipts and authorization must be rechecked at the admission ordering point, since the roster is only a read-time view.

- Worker suite: 93 tests passed, including six new roster cases; real Bot Repository and real Phase 1 SQLite Session Store exercised eviction, H-D2 revival and scoped reads with a controlled Host credential.

## Why

#1331 (`0b1a99508`) enrolled `tests/scenarios` as the `hive-scenarios` server suite. The isolated server run then refused it. Main's trusted `contracts_manifest()` raised `PackageProofError: incoming registry transition suite has an unreviewed shape: hive-scenarios`, because `transition_suite()` takes new enrolled suites only at `temp/<feature>/tests`. `9d6bd79f` reverted the row and its `INCOMING_REGISTRY` pin (plan: [#1331 F4 thread](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1331#discussion_r4572130582)).

The trusted run reads `scripts/ci` from the base branch, never from the PR. So the rule has to be on main before the row. This is PR 1 of 2. PR 2 adds only the `.github/ci-gates.json` row.

## Change

- `scripts/ci/server_contract_package.py`: adds `REVIEWED_PERMANENT_SUITES`, which holds one row, `hive-scenarios`: `discover`, `tests/scenarios`, `test_hive_*.py`, markers `test_hive_runner.py` and `test_hive_admission_steps.py`, `minimumTests` 20.
  - `registry_transition_rows()` accepts that name as an appended `enrolled` row only when it equals the reviewed row exactly, including key order. Any other shape is refused with `reviewed permanent suite has an unreviewed shape: hive-scenarios`.
  - `incoming_registry()` requires the row's path to be a real directory. It accepts a registry whose only appended row is this one, without a trusted policy, like the exact pin.
  - The row is optional. The row adds no `caseRoot`, `sourcePaths` or `sourcePackages` entry; the tests set up their own `sys.path`.
- Still fail-closed: `transition_suite()` is unchanged. A new suite at any other non-`temp/` path is still refused, and so is a `hive-scenarios` row with another owner, kind, path, pattern, markers, minimum, extra key or key order. The row cannot sit between pinned rows or repeat.
- Tests:
  - `test_installed_package_proof.py`: `TransitionRegistryRowTests` covers main's registry with and without the row, the pin plus only the row, every shape change, other permanent paths, `caseRoot`/`sourcePaths`/`sourcePackages` riders, a repeated key, and a missing, symlinked or file `tests/scenarios`. `test_main_registry_rows_are_admitted` leaves reviewed suites out of its expected feature set.
  - `test_contract_package.py`: full `contracts_manifest()` on the incoming layout, accepting the exact row and refusing its variants.
  - `test_suite_manifest.py`: `HiveScenarioSuiteTest`. If the registry has the row, it must equal the reviewed one. `load_registry()` accepts the registry either way. The real selector picks ≥ 20 tests from only the two runner modules, and a missing marker rejects the suite.
- Docs: `docs/guides/testing/ci-installed-package-proof.md` (registry rules), `ci.md` (single-group list), `UPDATES.md`.

## Local checks (Python 3.13, head `6cf9c72f4`, base main `336ab202e`)

| Check | main | this PR | this PR + PR 2's row |

| main | this PR + row | **refused**: `incoming registry transition suite has an unreviewed shape: hive-scenarios` (the original failure) |

The real selector also passes on this PR plus the row: `server-tests.py --suite hive-scenarios --require-tests --fail-on-skip` reports 20 tests, 0 skips, exit 0. That run's registry drops `installedContractsProfile`, so the sandbox-only installed launcher is skipped. Refs #1312 #1268 #1416

## 背景

#1416 修正了 `tests/architecture/fixture_controls.py` 的 `copy_transition_sources` 后，domain checker 第一次扫描到 `temp/hive-worker`。checker 只认直接写在 `execute/executemany/executescript` 调用里的字符串字面量，不认变量、f-string 或拼接，所以 `temp/hive-worker/src/dm_hive_worker/directory/repository.py` 里 6 处 `<dynamic SQL>` 让 `test_domains.py` 的 3 个用例失败：

- `test_real_schema_owner_and_existing_public_manager_pass`
- `test_sql_values_and_comments_do_not_invent_writers`
- `test_unrelated_sqlite_table_is_not_banned`

这个 PR 只解决 #1312 请求里 hive-worker 这一部分，所以用 Refs，不关 issue。

## 改动（只改 `repository.py`，行为不变）

| main 336ab202 行号 | 原写法 | 现写法 |
|---|---|---|
| 280 | `execute(f"PRAGMA busy_timeout = {...}")` | 删掉。`sqlite3.connect(timeout=busy_timeout_ms / 1000)` 本身就是调用 `sqlite3_busy_timeout`；已实测 `PRAGMA busy_timeout` 读回的值与配置一致（5000，以及 1/7/250/999/1234/30000 等取值） |
| 286 | `execute(f"BEGIN {mode}")` | 分成 `"BEGIN IMMEDIATE"` / `"BEGIN DEFERRED"` 两个字面量分支；其他 mode 抛 `ValueError`（现有调用只用到这两种） |
| 299 | `for statement in _SCHEMA: execute(statement)` | 改为 `_create_schema(connection)`，里面 7 条 `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` 各自是 `execute` 调用里的字面量，SQL 文本不变；仍在原来那次 `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` 事务里执行。没有用 `executescript`，避免它自带的隐式 COMMIT 改变事务边界 |
| 325 | `f"SELECT {_RECORD_COLUMNS} ..."`（`_definition`） | 列清单直接写进字面量 |
| 439 | `f"SELECT {_RECORD_COLUMNS} ..."`（`seed_beebou`） | 同上 |
| 491 | `f"SELECT {_RECORD_COLUMNS} ... state IN ({动态占位符})"`（`list_roster`） | 按 `include_retired` 分两个字面量分支：`IN (?, ?, ?)` / `IN (?, ?)`，参数不变 |

`_SCHEMA`、`_RECORD_COLUMNS` 两个模块内常量随之删除，仓库内没有其他引用。另外在 `test_hive_worker_repository.py` 加了一个小用例：连接的 `busy_timeout` 等于配置值、journal 为 WAL、两种事务模式可用、未知模式被拒。

## 验证（本地，Python 3.13.5）

- 本分支：`python3.13 -m unittest discover -s tests/architecture -p 'test_domains.py'` → 35 OK
- 本地临时合并 #1416 head（2cc02929）+ main + 本分支（未推送）：同一命令 → 35 OK
  - 对照：#1416 head + main、不带本分支 → 3 failures，finding 正好是 repository.py 的 280/286/299/325/439/491 这 6 处
- hive-worker 测试：`python -m unittest discover -s temp/hive-worker/tests -p 'test_*.py'`（agent-bridge venv）→ 81 OK
- 架构检查：`python3 -B tools/architecture/check.py --policy docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json --root . --format json` → findings 0

## 与 #1410 的关系

#1410（`hive2/beebou-preset-profile`）也改了 `repository.py`，但只改 `seed_beebou` 里构造 profile 的几行。本地试合并没有冲突，合并后 hive-worker 测试全过。

草稿 PR，不合入。

## Summary Adds the G3 gate (step 2.7) to the Hive scenario runner for #1314 / #1316: the 13 HIVE-SC-03 rows plus HIVE-SC-02's G3 segment (SC02-R1–R3, SC02-B1), each through a composed step in the product CLI assembly. In wheel mode on `hive/hive2-integration` 08dfec5c: 15 PASS / 0 FAIL / 2 BLOCKED. SC02-R1 waits for an effect-capable Bee (`bee_effect_steps`; the v3.1 lead keeps R1 as written) and SC02-R2 for Bee Stop. G1's SC01-W5 is re-specified to the #1268 scheme-two decision, including Local Memory isolation. - `run_hive.py --gate G3` selects the 13 HIVE-SC-03 rows registered in #1314: - SC03-R1–R3 from #1309; - SC03-B1–B8 from #1310; - SC03-D1–D2 from #1223. - Every row is `composed = true`. The evidence rules are unchanged: - PASS needs evidence and a real participant for every required role. - A substitute is allowed only where the row's `substitutable` names it, and it is labelled in the report. - A missing producer gives BLOCKED, naming the owner. - The candidates' `test_phase2_*` tests are owner tests. They never pass a row alone, and a skipped owner test never counts as a pass. ### Product entry The steps go through what `engine_cli serve --hive-results --hive-beebou-id --hive-turns [--hive-bees]` runs: - `configured_bridge` builds the Bridge; `create_app` serves it on a loopback TCP port. - The step drives the real `/digitalmate/ws` with the bearer token: concurrent sends, pushed events, reconnects and restarts. - It reads the product's own Store file read-only, and the Host journals and outcomes after the fact. - In wheel mode every module comes from the verified installed wheel. Only the `argparse` front of `serve` is not crossed. ### Bound steps | Row | Step | |---|---| | SC03-R1 | `hive_bees=True`: an owned Bee-only WorkSwarm process (pinned runtime, ask-only) and the WorkSwarm Bee Harness registered beside Beebou in one Registry. One home message goes through Beebou's dispatch to a real Bee. Both exact runtime bindings are stored and both factories are resolved. `BeebouHarness.run` and `WorkSwarmBeeHarness.run` each get their own scoped `HostAPI`, the Bee side bound to its Session and Run. The product's Host completion verifier witnesses the Run, and the owned process stops at shutdown. | | SC03-R2 | The same, then a restart where the exact `harness_version` is no longer registered (fault injection). Beebou still commits; that Bee's recovery returns `unavailable`, nothing is committed, and the persisted binding doesn't switch version. | | SC03-R3 | While the main turn is busy on a held read-only lookup, the Host refuses the quick reply's `dispatch` (`ToolNotGranted`, 0 executed) and the secondary preparation's `dispatch`. The normal turn keeps its Bot tools. The secondary preparation's read-only calls stay within `quick_reply.toml`'s allowlist and `max_tool_calls`. | | SC03-B1 | One runtime binding is committed and `HiveProfileLoader.resolve` resolves it. The `BeebouHarness` instance entered is the one the Registry returned, with a scoped `HostAPI`. | | SC03-B2 | Direct answer: one acceptance and one COMPLETED reply. After a restart, the same `message_id` makes no second model call. | | SC03-B3 | Same-language quick reply, 0 `tools.call` in its Host journal, and it passes the product's own `review_quick_text` claim check. | | SC03-B4 | Quick reply commits first; the normal turn sees it and publishes nothing new. The projection holds after reconnect and restart. | | SC03-B5 | Normal turn claims first; the late candidate is `QUICK_LATE`, no quick reply is sent, and the projection holds after restart. | | SC03-B6 | After the user's correction, the Shanghai material is `superseded`, never reused, and both normal turns look up again (`reused_material: false`). | | SC03-B7 | The first committed NewTask ACK is dropped at the real `AdmissionReceiver`. Delivery's retry under the original `message_id` returns the same `task_ref`, with one task and one input. | | SC03-B8 | (Scope: #1310's row names no Local Memory, so B8 asserts a new ID, Session and effective information; private Local Memory isolation is SC01-W5's.) Follows the #1268 scheme-two decision ([comment](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1268#issuecomment-6873130205), which supersedes #1228 H-D2). Branches: new registration; active reuse keeps the ID and Session; the LRU idle Bee is evicted with the Host's WorkSwarm release witness; `activate_bee` for the evicted ID is refused (`RETIRED`, no new claim), a replay returns the same refusal, the ID never appears among active Bees, and a dispatch to it creates no task; a similar task creates a new Bee from its Profile (new ID, Session and its own effective information); CAPACITY_BUSY keeps the new `bee_id`. With `retire_evicted_identity = false` the step stops after eviction and reports BLOCKED. | | SC03-D1 | The real Beebou normal turn dispatches. The Store admits the exact task text, and the Bee runtime's own model input carries it. | | SC03-D2 | The done report reaches Beebou as an EVENT authored by the Bee, and the terminal is readable on its own. There is one notice obligation, pushed once and not re-pushed after a restart, and `hive.result.get` replays the same event (version 1). | ### Labelled substitutes and witnesses - `model_provider`: #1314's controlled OpenAI-compatible endpoint (JSON, or SSE for the Bee runtime) behind the product's Model Gateway. - The owner tables explicitly allow it only on SC03-R1 (#1309) and SC03-B2/B3 (#1310). - On every other row it is #1314's allowance, pending owner confirmation. B1, B4–B7 and D1 came with the HIVE1 runner's rows; this PR adds R2, R3, B8 and D2. - `tool_provider`: #1314's controlled read-only weather tool, registered via `HiveTurnStartup.register_readonly_tool`. - B8: a controlled WorkSwarm wire below the real adapter, and a controlled completion verifier that the step checks is never called. - R1, R2, D1 and D2 run the real owned WorkSwarm process and the product's own verifier; no wire or verifier substitute. - Also: `ScriptedBackend` for non-Hive Engine turns, B7's ACK fault proxy, R2's version fault injection, and delegating recorders on `resolve`, `run`, `WorkSwarmBeeHarness.run` and `BeeExecutionBridge.run_next`. - Runner timeouts and stand-in settings are in `sc03_controls.toml`. ### Producer rows - `store_quick_reply` names `HiveReplyOrdering`. - From #1437: `beebou_quick_reply`. - From #1439: `bee_revive` and `host_slot_release`. - From #1442: `cli_workswarm_registration` and `bee_completion_verifier`. - `bee_report` also probes #1426's notice publisher. - Owner tests include #1426's, #1437's, #1442's, #1451's and #1455's journeys. ### Runner environment - The scenario child keeps the caller's proxy variables and always names loopback in `NO_PROXY`. Without any proxy variable, Python on macOS falls back to the system proxy, and the owned Bee runtime's model client then sends loopback requests through it (502). - When the scenario interpreter has the pinned WorkSwarm runtime, the child sets `WORKSWARM_RUNTIME_TESTS=1`, so runtime owner tests run instead of skipping. - The report records the proxy variable names (never values) and the runtime version. - Without the runtime, R1, R2, D1 and D2 are BLOCKED with an environment reason. ### HIVE-SC-02's G3 segment #1314 registers SC02-R1–R3 (#1309) and SC02-B1 (#1310) as HIVE-SC-02's G3 execution segment. #1316's G3 Test Verification names real steer, Stop, question answers and concurrency. They run under `--gate G3`; `sc02.run` hands G3 rows to the same composed-step table. | Row | Status | |---|---| | SC02-R1 | BLOCKED on `bee_effect_steps` (#1309): the product's Bee runtime is ask-only, so no Bee sample can propose an external effect or have calls in execution. Steer itself reaches a Bee through Beebou. | | SC02-R2 | BLOCKED on `bee_stop` (#1309): no product Stop for a Bee Run; Stop over the real WorkSwarm Gateway is the open #1382. | | SC02-R3 | **PASS**: two Bees hold slots and the Bee scheduler has claimed one's turn (RUNNING). Releasing the idle one through the Host's WorkSwarm witness leaves the busy Bee's binding and running turn unchanged; it keeps accepting work, and a call to the released old generation is refused. | | SC02-B1 | **PASS** (#1393/#1395, real owned Bee runtime):
• the Bee asks through `ask_user` and `hive.result.get` shows a `waiting_user` card;
• Beebou's notify-only `status` input wakes no normal turn;
• `task.answer` with the original `interaction_id` is consumed at the Bee's wait point: the Bee resumes and commits, the interaction is ANSWERED, and no Beebou dispatch is made;
• the report-woken Beebou turn's dispatch (new) and steer are both denied, with no task and no steer control. | ### G1 SC01-W5 under scheme two [#1268's decision](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1268#issuecomment-6873130205) supersedes #1228 H-D2 and rewrites W5. On main G1 therefore reads 21 PASS + W5 BLOCKED. - W5's H-D2 owner test is replaced by the scheme-two reference test. - SC01-W3, S4, D2 and W6 use revival only to build an old generation and are unaffected. ## Row status: integration 08dfec5c + 99641aa5 (combination d7bbaf58), wheel mode, main 2ae871a6 - G3 (17 rows): 15 PASS / 0 FAIL / 2 BLOCKED (SC02-R1, R2; reasons above). - G1: 22/22. - SC03-R2 records the fail-closed state it leaves for owner reconciliation: the unavailable Run stays RUNNING and its task stays open. - `settings.py`：校验新表、未知键、缺键，以及每种加载的 `per_category_chars ≤ total_chars`。不读每值环境变量，没有隐藏的数值回退。
- 新增 `dm_beebou/memory/load.py`（Beebou Harness owner）
  - 条目通过注入的 `LocalMemoryReader.entries_for_task(task_ref, keys)` 读取。
  - 只保留已授权、未过期、`ACTIVE` 的条目，按 `entry_id` 取最高 revision 去重。撤权（REVOKED）条目和未发布的封存条目（SEALED_UNPUBLISHED）既不计数，也不进入模型输入。
  - 先按每键上限、再按单次总长上限选取。条目不截断，放不下就略过，并记录原因。
  - 对每个键给出 `query_global` 判定：有效 Local 条数 ≤ 阈值时可以查 Global，超过阈值不查。
  - `merge_global` 只把调用方取得的 Global 条目在剩余预算内补进允许查 Global 的键，同样复核撤权、未发布状态和重复。
  - 分类名是调用方传入的不透明字符串。#999 分类未冻结，这里不命名、也不校验官方分类。
  - **不写 Store，不实现 Global Memory provider**（Global provider 由 #1312 线负责，见 #1416）。
- 登记：`module-ownership.json` 新增 `beebou-config-memory`、`beebou-memory-package`、`beebou-memory-load` 三行；`server_package_proof.py` 的 `BEEBOU_MODULES` / `BEEBOU_RESOURCES` 与 `Dockerfile.dockerignore` 同步；已安装包证明测试也已覆盖。

与 Bee 身份的关系：产品方向是方案二。被驱逐的 Bee 不复用原 ID，新 Bee 拿新的 `bee_id`、新 Session 和独立的 Local Memory；新 Bee 读不到原 Bee 的私有 Local Memory，只能读已发布且有授权的 Global Memory。目前 main 上合入的 Phase 1 Store 默认仍是 H-D2 原 ID 复活（`retire_evicted_identity=false`），方案二作为 Phase 2 增量，还要和 Store/Runtime owner 对齐。本 PR 不改 Store 默认值，也不依赖任何一种身份语义：Local 条目的可见范围由注入的读取端口按当前任务和权限给出。

## 测试（本地，base `336ab202`）

```
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=temp/beebou/src python -m pytest -q temp/beebou/tests        # 142 passed
python tools/architecture/check.py --policy docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json --root . --format text   # exit 0
python -m pytest -q tests/architecture                                                             # 232 passed, 446 subtests
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/server/test_installed_package_proof.py tests/server/test_beebou_trusted_enrollment.py   # 47 passed, 129 subtests
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/scenarios/test_hive_runner.py   # 17 passed
```

预期 CI：受信清单读的是 base 上的 `module-ownership.json`，而本 PR 新增了 dm_beebou 模块和资源，所以清单登记进 base 之前，官方安装证明和受信扫描可能会红。

## 参与方（真实 / 替身）

- 真实：打包的 `memory.toml` 与 `load_settings` 校验，架构检查，包证明脚本。
- **替身**：`ListReader` 代替 Local Memory owner 的读取端口；Global 条目是手工构造的值，代替 Global provider。没有真实 Store、Local Memory owner、Global provider、Host、Model Gateway 或 Bee 参与。**这些测试不算 G3、HIVE-SC-03 或 HIVE-SC-05 的验收。**

## 未完成 / 待定

- 阈值边界：本 PR 按「≤ 阈值可查」实现（3 条时可以查）。规则原文另有「达到阈值不查」的表述，等于 3 时两处说法矛盾，需要产品或 #1310 owner 确认。

1426.author: Jianyu010
1426.body:
Project Hive Phase 2, step 2.3 (#1223 Delivery, RFC #1316, design #1228), dev E: SC03-D2 terminal notification obligation.

**Stacks on #1374** (`hive2/live-recovery` @ `4f40634a`, merged in). Base stays `main`, but this lands **through `hive/hive2-integration`**. Do not merge it to `main` directly.

## SC03-D2
A report keeps the Bee as its author. `done` and the committed terminal can be queried separately. A terminal notification replayed under its original event ID is delivered once.

- `done` is the `dm_hive_inputs` kind='done' row. Unchanged: a Bee `done` still marks the task `completed`, per the HIVE1 contract.
- The terminal is `dm_hive_user_results`. The new **notification obligation** is `dm_hive_result_notices`.

## Changes
- **Store (`hive_busy.py`)**: new table `dm_hive_result_notices(workspace_id, principal_id, event_id, task_ref, run_id, version, created_at_ms, published_at_ms NULL, publish_witness NULL)`, PK (workspace, principal, event_id), UNIQUE (workspace, principal, task_ref, version), plus a partial index on unpublished rows.
  - `commit_text_result` inserts version 1 inside its existing `body()`.
  - `event_id = "hive-result-" + sha256(workspace, principal, task_ref, run_id, version)`.
  - On success, and on an identical replay, it returns the notice. An identical replay never creates a second row. A replay with different text returns `False` and creates no notice. A result without a notice is refused with an error, since this writer always commits both rows together.
  - New methods:
    - `read_result_notice(scope, task_ref)`: the latest version.
    - `list_unpublished_notices(scope, *, limit)`: in created order, capped by `hive_store.toml [results] page_limit`.
    - `mark_notice_published(scope, event_id, witness, *, now_ms, host)`: idempotent, uses `authenticated_host`, keeps the first witness.
  - The SQL is written as plain literals.
- **Frame identity (`hive_bee_execution.py`)**: `digitalmate.task.text` now carries `event_id` and `version`, with `committed_message_id = event_id`. The frame builder is shared by `BeeExecutionBridge.committed_frame`, `HiveCommittedReader` and the publisher. Reconnect pull (`hive.result.get`) returns the same event_id and version whether or not the notice was published.
- **`HiveResultPublisher`** sits next to `HiveReportRecovery`.
  - It scans unpublished notices, broadcasts each frame, and marks the notice only after the broadcast returns.
  - If the broadcast fails or the mark outcome is unknown, the pass ends and the notice stays owed.
  - A crash between broadcast and mark re-sends the same event_id.
  - `make_result_publisher` binds it to the workspace Store writer and the verified Host capability.
- **Bridge lifecycle (`server.py`)**: `configure_hive_result_publisher` starts and stops the publisher next to report recovery. It is wired when the Hive bootstrap exists, which means `--hive-results --hive-beebou-id`. The marker needs the bootstrap's Host authority and Store writer, and `--hive-results` alone has only the read-only `HiveCommittedReader`.
- **Tunables**: new `temp/hive-worker/src/dm_hive_worker/config/bee_execution.toml` holds the report recovery interval and the publisher interval and page limit. It is loaded by `settings.load_bee_execution`, which refuses missing or invalid keys. The hard-coded `interval=10.0` defaults are gone. The Store page cap is in `hive_store.toml [results] page_limit`.
- **Ownership**: `temp/hive-worker/ownership.json` registers `BeeExecutionSettings`, `load_bee_execution`, `HiveResultPublisher` and `make_result_publisher`, and allows `hive-worker-config` for the bridge adapter. `docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json` is unchanged.

## Tests
- New `tests/scenarios/hive/test_phase2_sc03_d2.py` runs on the real SQLite Store:
  - (a) the done report is role EVENT, author_role `bee`, authored by the Bee, not user origin;
  - (b) a done that arrives before the commit is queryable while no notice exists, and the notice exists after the commit;
  - (c) crash after commit and before publish: a reopened Store and a new publisher deliver the same event_id once, and a second scan sends nothing;
  - (d) crash after broadcast and before mark, and an unknown mark: the same event_id is re-sent, never a new one, and there is one notice row;
  - (e) reconnect pull through `bind_result_gateway` and `HiveCommittedReader` gives the same event_id and version before and after publishing;
  - (f) a replayed commit with different text is refused and creates no notice.
- `test_hive_live_recovery_startup.py`: the restarted real Bridge's publisher delivers the persisted notice by its original event_id.
- `test_hive_result_gateway_startup.py`: the fixture adds the notice row, and the pull asserts event_id and version.
- New `temp/hive-worker/tests/test_hive_worker_bee_execution_settings.py`.

### Participants versus substitutes
| Role | In these tests |
|---|---|
| SQLite EngineStore and Store writer (`SQLiteSessionRepository`, `HiveBusyControls`) | participant |
| BotRepository, Directory, Delivery, BotTools, AdmissionReceiver | participant |
| WorkSwarmAdapter, BeeExecutionBridge, `bind_result_gateway`, `HiveCommittedReader`, `HiveResultPublisher` | participant |
| Real Bridge startup and stop with `HiveLocalHostAuthority` (startup tests) | participant |
| Remote WorkSwarm computation (`SumSocket`) | substitute |
| Host witness (`ControlledHost` token, controlled isolation verifier) | substitute |
| Gateway broadcast in the scenario (a frame recorder) | substitute |
| Process crash (Store reopen, patched `mark_notice_published`) | substitute |

### Commands and results
Run in a Python 3.12 venv (`uv venv -p 3.12`, `uv pip install -e . -e harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge -e harness/agent-core pytest pytest-asyncio`), with PYTHONPATH set to `tests/scenarios:harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src:harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests:<every temp/*/src>:temp/hive-worker/tests:harness/workswarm`.

```

# exit 0, 0 findings (checked 172 of 417 files)
python -m unittest hive.test_phase2_bee_execution hive.test_phase2_delivery_receipts hive.test_phase2_reference hive.test_phase2_sc03_d2 hive.test_phase2_text_flow hive.test_phase2_workswarm_memory
# Ran 42 tests, OK (skipped=1: test_model_inputs_across_reuse_neighbours_and_eviction, "requires the pinned runtime wheels")

# 253 passed, 4 subtests passed
```

1429.author: huben0423-hw
1429.body:
## 目的

Phase 2 开发 D（#1310 Beebou）主链路中的一段：Bee 回报 `done` 并进入 Beebou Inbox 后，Beebou 起一轮由 Bee 触发的回复，再推给用户。在这一轮里，Beebou 不能创建 Bee，也不能派发或 steer。

## 请只审阅这 3 个提交

| 提交 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| `e2d5593c` | 真实入口消费已提交的 Bee `done`，推送 `hive.beebou.reply` |
| `a5d945b2` | 稳定 `event_id`，覆盖旧 Run、并发和重复的情况 |
| `0bc07f49` | Bee 回报唤醒的这一轮拒绝 Bot 动作；可靠交付缺口的复现测试 |

**固定 head `0bc07f49`**，只改 3 个文件：`hive_turn_startup.py`、`server.py`、`tests/test_hive_bee_induced_reply.py`。

本 PR 的 base 是 `main`，因为 CI 只对 main 跑。代码建立在 `hive/hive2-integration@0f54793c` 之上，所以对 main 的 diff 里，除了上面 3 个提交，其余内容都已经在 H2（#1421）里，不需要在这里审。改动依赖的 H2 内容：

| 依赖内容 | 来源（H2 合并提交 / PR） |
| --- | --- |
| `hive_turn_startup.py` 本身 | `fbef6c8c`，#1379 / #1378 |
| `claim_beebou_context`、`read_beebou_context_binding`、`commit_beebou_context` | `b5a28fd7`，#1371 |
| `done` 认领 | `f753a889`，#1377 |
| `BeebouToolGuard` 和工具计划 | `557ce494`，#1365 |
| Beebou 模型和工具 | `041d619a`，#1356 / #1364 |
| SC03-D2 通知 | `0f54793c`，#1426 |

在 main 上直接 cherry-pick 这几个提交会冲突（`hive_turn_startup.py` 是 DU 冲突），所以不能从 main 重建。H2 现在已经前进到 `acc1496b`（#1426 的更新），本 head 和它试合并没有冲突。按约定不再追 H2，由集成 owner 按固定 SHA 挑入。

## 改了什么

- `run_input` 同时接受 `user` 和 `done`。能不能进入这一轮，由 Store 的 `claim_beebou_context` 决定：Host 已经提交了对应的终态，并且没有待处理的用户输入。
- 新增 `drain_inbox()`：
  - 按 Store 顺序执行，用户输入优先。
  - 遇到 `user_pending`、`busy` 或 `observed` 就停止。
  - `done` 返回 `stale` 时留在 Inbox，不消费。
- 回复提交以后推送 `hive.beebou.reply`。`event_id` 的格式是 `beebou-reply:<run_id>`，其中 `run_id` 由 `session_ref` 和 `source_seq` 推导，跨重试、跨重启都不变。字段有 `trigger`（`bee_done` 或 `user`）、`source_seq`、`source_message_id`、`task_ref`、`bee_id`、`run_id`、`text` 和 `final`。
- 由 `done` 唤醒的这一轮使用 `_BeeReportTurnTools`。它只放行 `list_bees`；`create_bee` 和 `dispatch`（包括 new、reuse、queue、steer）一律返回 `{"status":"rejected","code":"not_granted_in_bee_report_turn"}`。拒绝发生在 `BeebouToolGuard` 里面，意图仍会记成已完成的工具计划，`commit_beebou_context` 的计划核对也能对上，所以这一轮能正常完成，不会把认领卡在 RUNNING。只有已受理的用户输入才带用户动作授权。
- 没有改 Store 写入、Delivery、E 接手的文件和 Phase 1。`retire_evicted_identity` 的默认值不变，也没有新增配置项。

## 与 #1431 的关系

`_BeeReportTurnTools` 是过渡实现，语义上对应 #1431 的 `BeebouToolGrant(stage=NORMAL, user_action_authorized=False)`。#1431 进入集成以后，在 `HiveTurnStartup.run_input` 的 `bind_tools` 处替换掉它：

- `user_action_authorized` 只在 `message.kind == 'user'` 时为 True。
- registry 由可信的工具 owner 提供。

#1431 需要配合的有两点：

1. 拒绝不能用抛出 `PermissionError` 的方式放在 `BeebouToolGuard` 里面。那样计划会停在已预留、未完成的状态，`commit_beebou_context` 返回 `unresolved`，认领就会卡在 RUNNING（见下面的缺口 b）。可以二选一：
   - 改为返回结构化的拒绝结果；
   - 把 gate 放在 Guard 外面，同时 Harness 按阶段只向模型提供已授权的工具。
2. 目前 `BeebouHarness(BEE_TOOLS)` 的工具清单在 Registry 里是固定的，不同阶段看到的都一样。要按阶段裁剪，需要 #1309/#1310 的 Harness 让 Host 能按 stage 下发工具清单。

## 可靠交付缺口

**立即 broadcast 不等于可靠交付。** 本 PR 的推送是尽力而为，只在 Store 条件提交之后发出。下面 4 项各有一个 `strict xfail` 测试，断言的是应有行为，现在预期失败。它们不算通过；哪天意外通过了，会以 XPASS 报错。

公共前置：
```
R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); PP="$R:$R/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src:$(ls -d $R/temp/*/src | paste -sd:):$R/tests/scenarios:$R/harness/agent-core:$R/harness/workswarm"
cd harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge
PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=$PP python -m pytest -q --runxfail tests/test_hive_bee_induced_reply.py -k <测试名>
```
加 `--runxfail` 可以看到实际失败的断言；不加时显示为 XFAIL。

### (a) 提交后、推送前断线：重启后无法重放（owner：B / Store，参照 #1426 `dm_hive_result_notices`）

- 复现：`test_gap_a_reply_lost_between_commit_and_push_is_replayed`。在 `test_hive_bee_induced_reply.py:335` 失败：`assert [] == ['beebou-reply:beebou-…']`。
- 原因：`commit_beebou_context`（`hive_store.py:649`，`0f54793c`）只写上下文头、回复并消费 Inbox，没有登记投递义务。输入已经被消费，恢复循环看不到它；也没有公开读取接口能列出未发布的回复。`hive.result.get` 只重读 Bee 自己的结果，不能当作 Beebou 回复的重放。
- 最小接口：
  - 在 `commit_beebou_context` 的同一事务里插入 `dm_hive_beebou_reply_notices(workspace_id, principal_id, event_id, session_ref, source_seq, run_id, created_at_ms, published_at_ms)`。`event_id` 稳定，可以直接用 `beebou-reply:<run_id>`；提交与通知要么都成功，要么都回滚。
  - `list_unpublished_beebou_replies(scope, *, limit) -> tuple[dict, ...]`：按 `created_at_ms` 排序，页大小取 `[results] page_limit`。
  - `mark_beebou_reply_published(scope, event_id, witness, *, now_ms, host) -> bool | None`：幂等。`False` 表示没有这条记录，`None` 表示结果未知。
  - `read_beebou_reply(scope, event_id) -> dict | None`：供客户端重连时拉取。

### (b) 模型调用中途崩溃：认领永远停在 RUNNING（owner：B / Store）

- 复现：`test_gap_b_claim_left_running_by_a_crash_is_recovered`。用受控模型制造 500，claim 之后 `run_harness` 抛错，然后重启。在 `:355` 失败：`assert [] == ['bee_done']`。
- 原因：`claim_beebou_context` 只要已有记录就返回 `observed`（`hive_store.py:553`），不区分 RUNNING 和 COMPLETED。同一 session 后续的认领又被 `running` 检查挡住，返回 `busy`（`hive_store.py:597-601`）。结果是这条输入和之后所有 Beebou 输入都卡住，用户输入也一样。
- 最小接口：`resume_beebou_context(scope, session_ref, generation, source_seq, stale_run_id, new_run_id, *, host, lease_witness) -> dict`。Host 证明旧 Run 已失效（租约过期或隔离见证）后，在同一事务里：
  - 把旧 run 标为 `ABANDONED`；
  - 检查旧 run 已完成的工具计划。有已完成的副作用计划就返回 `reconcile`；
  - 否则以同一个 `start_json` 发出新的 `claimed`。

### (c) Inbox 里的 `status` 永远不被消费，还会把 `done` 挤出页面（owner：E 定语义，B / Store 提供接口）

- 复现（c1）：`test_gap_c1_status_report_is_consumed_or_acknowledged`。在 `:370` 失败，`kind='status'` 那条一直留在 `peek_beebou_inbox` 里。
- 复现（c2）：`test_gap_c2_unconsumed_status_does_not_starve_done`。在 `:390` 失败：`assert [] == ['bee_done']`。测试把 `task_page_limit` 设为 1，用来代替真实情况：`page_limit=50`，`status_per_task=4`，有 13 个活跃任务时就会出现。

1437.author: Jianyu010
1437.body:
Project Hive Phase 2 (RFC #1316, design #1228), gate G3 (HIVE-SC-03): the #1310 producer entry **`beebou_quick_reply`**, which blocks SC03-R3, B3, B4, B5 and B6.

**Cut from `hive/hive2-integration` @ `440b12c5`, then merged with `305282dd` (#1435, Bee-induced reply).** Base stays `main`, but this lands **through `hive/hive2-integration`**. Do not merge it to `main` directly.

## What was missing
Nothing in the product called the Store's H-C7 ordering (`HiveReplyOrdering`, #1311 on main), and the Host tool gate admitted only `list_bees`, `create_bee` and `dispatch`. A user message admitted while the Beebou main turn was busy waited silently.

## The quick-reply path
`hive.message.send` now admits the message first, outside the turn lock. If a Beebou normal turn is running, the Host starts two restricted executions of the same Registry-bound Beebou Harness in parallel:

| Execution | Snapshot it reads | Host grant | Output |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Quick reply** | `message_id@generation:context_revision:inbox_seq`: committed context (budget in TOML), the task digest, this message | inference only; `tools=()` offered; any `tools.call` is refused by `QuickToolGate` and journalled | a candidate, conditionally committed by `claim_quick_reply` → `commit_quick_reply` |
| **Second quick** | the same snapshot | inference plus the TOML read-only allowlist, within its own call, per-call timeout and total budget (`SecondQuickToolGate`) | material for the original message; never published |
| **Normal turn** | Store claim plus, when published, the quick reply and a TOML note | Bee tools (`BeebouToolGuard`) plus the read-only allowlist (`ReviewedReadOnlyTools`) | the reply; published again only if it adds something |

- **Same language and no unreceipted outcome.** The quick prompt asks for the user's language. Before commit, Beebou mechanically drops a candidate that is empty, over the length budget, claims an outcome (`completion_claims` in TOML), or whose dominant script differs from the message's (unless the message names a reply language). A dropped candidate leaves the plain "accepted" receipt.
- **Ordering.** `run_input` calls `claim_normal_turn` before the normal turn runs. This seals a late quick candidate (`QUICK_LATE`) and returns one already committed. The quick reply is pushed (`{"event": "hive.reply", "phase": "quick"}`) only from `read_reply_projection` after `QUICK_COMMITTED`.
- **No repeat.** The normal turn's input carries the published quick reply. When its answer is the same text, `answer` is `null` and only `quick_reply` is returned.
- **Second-quick reuse only after a structured review.** The normal turn's read-only call reuses material only if all of these hold: same message, same Session generation, same normalized parameters, tool still granted, not expired, and no later user input admitted after it (a correction supersedes it). Every decision is journalled (`reused`, `arguments_differ`, `expired`, `superseded`, `stale_generation`, `not_granted`, `no_material`); otherwise the tool is called again.
- **Display, withdrawal, reconnect.** New Gateway methods `hive.reply.projection {message_id}` and `hive.reply.displayed {message_id}` read `read_reply_projection` and record `record_quick_displayed`. A withdrawn quick reply disappears from the projection, and the normal reply is then shown on its own.
- **Limits.** At most one quick execution per Session at a time, plus a global limit; saturation only skips the quick reply.

## Merge with #1435
`run_input` takes both `user` and `done` inputs. Only a user input claims the H-C7 normal turn and keeps Bot actions. A Bee-report turn keeps #1435's `_BeeReportTurnTools` refusal; it also gets the Host read-only tools, but never reuses material. **One small hunk in #1435's `drain_inbox`:** it skips the `hive.beebou.reply` push when the normal turn adds nothing to an already published quick reply (that reply's `answer` is `null`).

## Files
| Partition (owner) | Files |
| --- | --- |
| Beebou Harness (#1310) | `temp/hive-beebou/src/dm_hive_beebou/harness/quick.py` (new): the quick and second-quick executions and their checks. `harness/normal.py`: `run_quick` and `run_second_quick` on `BeebouHarness`, and Host-granted read-only schemas in the normal turn's tool list. `config/quick_reply.toml` and `config/settings.py` (new): prompts, budgets, read-only allowlist, concurrency. |
| Host / Backend (#1309), `temp/hive-runtime` | `assembly/turn_grants.py` (new): per-turn-kind gates, `ReadOnlyCatalog`, `MaterialLedger` and the review. `assembly/quick_runner.py` (new): Host execution over `RunOperations` / `HostAPI` and the H-C7 calls. **Small hunks in #1309 files:** `tool_guard.py` takes `readonly=` names, which pass without a plan reservation like `list_bees`; `beebou_native.py` takes `readonly_tools=` and a `prelude=` of already-published reply phases. |
| Bridge assembly | `server_engine/hive_quick_reply.py` (new adapter). `hive_turn_startup.py`: admit outside the lock, start the quick path while a normal turn runs, normal claim and prelude, `register_readonly_tool`. **Shared `server.py`: 2 lines** register `hive.reply.projection` and `hive.reply.displayed` next to `hive.message.send`. No scheduler or verifier wiring is touched. |
| Store (#1311, **HIVE1-owned code**) | `hive_store.py` and `repository.py`: two **read-only** methods, `read_beebou_context_head` (the quick snapshot) and `read_beebou_reply` (the projection's normal phase). Plain SQL literals; no schema or writer change. |
| Ownership | `temp/hive-beebou/ownership.json`: new `hive-beebou-config`, quick publics, adapter `hive-quick-reply-bridge`. `temp/hive-runtime/ownership.json`: assembly publics. `docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json` is unchanged. |

Transition record (temp/AGENTS.md): the entry is `hive.message.send` → `HiveTurnStartup`. The sole writer of reply phases is the Store's `HiveReplyOrdering`. Material is **in-process** (`MaterialLedger`): after a restart the normal turn looks the value up again. Persisting material references belongs to #1311 and is a follow-up. #1409 (`restricted-bee-tool-gate`) gates WorkSwarm Bee runs, not Beebou executions, so nothing was ported from it.

## Tests
`tests/scenarios/hive/test_phase2_quick_reply.py` runs over the real CLI assembly (`configured_bridge(..., hive_turns=True)`), `/digitalmate/ws`, the Registry-bound Beebou, the Host runners and the SQLite Store. M1 keeps the main turn busy inside the controlled read-only tool.

| `test_busy_quick_reply_is_same_language_and_reviewed_material_is_reused` | B3, R3, B6 (reuse) | Chinese quick frame for M2; quick request offered no tools; Host quick journal 0 executed / 0 requested; second quick prepared 1 material; normal turn reuses it after review (`reused`, provider not called again); normal input contains the quick reply |
| `test_quick_first_normal_turn_adds_nothing_and_reconnect_projects_once` | B4 | committed quick reaches the normal turn; identical answer → `answer: null`; `hive.reply.displayed` recorded; reconnect and product restart project the quick phase once; withdrawal hides it and the normal phase stands alone |

1439.body:
Project Hive Phase 2, gate G3 (HIVE-SC-03, RFC #1316, design #1228): the producer entries for **SC03-B8's revive branch**. Owners: #1310 (Beebou tool) and #1309 (Host slot release).

**Cut from `hive/hive2-integration` @ `440b12c5`, then merged with `33e821c1`.** Base stays `main`, but this lands **through `hive/hive2-integration`**. Do not merge it to `main` directly.

HIVE2 QA (#1424) already passes new registration, active reuse and CAPACITY_BUSY through the product. It reported that reviving an archived original `bee_id` had no product path. This PR adds the three missing pieces.

## What changes

### 1. Beebou `activate_bee` tool (#1310)
- `dm_hive_beebou.selection.BEE_TOOLS` offers `activate_bee {bee_id}` next to `list_bees`, `create_bee` and `dispatch`. `BeeSelectionTools` validates the arguments and derives the same stable operation ID as the other tools (scope, Beebou, admitted message_id and tool call ID).
- New `dm_hive_worker/directory/revival.py`:
  - `activate_known_bee` checks with the Bot Repository that the ID is a REGISTERED Bee in this scope. Otherwise it returns `not_found`, `not_a_bee` or `retired`.
  - It then calls the Store's H-C3 `activate_bot` under the original `bee_id`. The Store decides the outcome: reuse of the ACTIVE generation, a new generation in a free slot, an eviction claim (PENDING) or CAPACITY_BUSY.
  - This is **H-D2 original-ID revival**. The opt-in #1268 rule still lives in the Store: with `retire_evicted_identity=true`, the Store refuses an evicted identity (`RETIRED`).
  - `generate_bee` is register plus `activate_known_bee`. It takes the same steps and operation IDs as `roster.prepare_generated_bee`, which is unchanged, but it keeps the new `bee_id` in every outcome.
- `server_engine/hive_beebou_tools.py` binds the tool. Every `create_bee` and `activate_bee` receipt is `{status, bee_id}`. A PENDING activation is first settled by the Host slot release (below).
- **Replay.** Repeating the same operation ID joins the original Store activation claim. No second claim is created, and the receipt is that claim's receipt. The test checks the claim rows.
- **Tool gate.** `BeebouToolGuard` (`tool_guard.py`) and the Store's `commit_beebou_context` effect check (`hive_store.py`) count `activate_bee` as an effect. Each is a one-word change, and the turn kinds are untouched.

### 2. Host-owned caller of `confirm_slot_release` (#1309)
- New `server_engine/hive_slot_release.py` (`HiveSlotRelease`), registered as an adapter in `temp/hive-worker/ownership.json`. For one eviction it:
  1. reads the claim through the new Store read `read_eviction`;
  2. asks the **Bee WorkSwarm adapter** to release the victim generation's runtime scope. That scope is the same one the Bee turn opens in `text_run`; a test pins this;
  3. confirms only from a real witness:
     - `workswarm-released:<proof>`: `session.unload` acknowledged `RELEASED` for the scope's session (and the session it replaced);
     - `workswarm-never-opened:<proof>`: the adapter's durable mapping file agrees with memory that the generation never opened a runtime session. `_create` records `creating` before any `session.create`, so absence is a WorkSwarm-owner fact.
  4. **Fails closed** on `STILL_IN_USE`, `UNKNOWN`, an unknown creation outcome, a damaged or missing mapping file, or no Bee adapter. The slot stays RELEASING and the victim stays EVICTING.

  The proof is deterministic, so a retry after a restart replays the Store's recorded witness instead of conflicting.
- New `WorkSwarmAdapter.release_scoped_session(scope_id)` returns `(status, proof)`. The token lookup in `release_session` moved into `_release_token`, with no behavior change.
- **Bridge lifecycle.**
  - The tool settles a PENDING activation inline.
  - `Bridge.configure_hive_slot_release(workswarm)` also starts a recovery task next to report recovery and the result publisher, and stops it with them. Each pass runs over the new Store read `list_claimed_evictions`, oldest first. Its interval and page size are in the new `hive_slot_release.toml`.
  - The adapter must be the Bee scheduler's adapter.
  - `engine_cli.configured_bridge` wires it whenever `bee_adapter` is given. The `server.py` hunk is a new method plus one start line and one stop line. The scheduler and verifier lines are unchanged.

### 3. CAPACITY_BUSY carries the `bee_id`
`create_bee` and `activate_bee` now return `{'status': 'CAPACITY_BUSY', 'bee_id': ...}`. PENDING and rejections carry it too.

## Edits to code owned by others (stated per the standing rules)
- **#1311 Store** (`hive_store.py`, `repository.py`): two read-only methods, `read_eviction` and `list_claimed_evictions`, plus a value type `SlotEviction` that callers read through attributes only. Also the one-word effect-set change above. The schema and every write are unchanged, and the SQL is plain literals.
- **#1268 hive-worker**: new `directory/revival.py` and its public names in `ownership.json`. `roster.py` is unchanged.
- **Bridge `workswarm_adapter.py`** (legacy-workswarm, unchecked): the additive `release_scoped_session` and `_durable_scope`, and the `_release_token` extraction.
- **#1309 tool gate** (`tool_guard.py`): `activate_bee` is added to the effect set.
- `docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json` is unchanged.

The Beebou core, tools and prompt registry identities (`hive-beebou-normal-v1`, `beebou-prompt-v1`) are not bumped. Bumping them would make an existing persisted Beebou binding fail to resolve at startup. The prompt text is unchanged; the model learns about revival from the tool description.

## Tests
- **New product-entry test `tests/scenarios/hive/test_phase2_bee_revive.py`.** It runs over the real CLI assembly: `configured_bridge(..., bee_adapter=WorkSwarmAdapter, bee_verify_completion=...)`, the Gateway WebSocket `hive.message.send`, and Beebou normal turns with a controlled model.
  - `ReviveJourney` fills all 4 slots and evicts the LRU Bee B1. The Host proves B1's release by `session.unload`, and the Store records `workswarm-released:` and archives B1.
  - It then revives B1 by its original ID while the next victim B2's runtime reports `STILL_IN_USE`. The result is `{'status': 'PENDING', 'bee_id': B1}`: the eviction stays CLAIMED, B2 stays EVICTING, the slot stays RELEASING and nothing is confirmed. A replay of the same operation ID gives the same receipt and no new claim.
  - Once the runtime releases B2, the lifecycle pass confirms it. B1 becomes ACTIVE at generation 2 on a new Session, and a replay returns `{'status': 'ACTIVE', 'bee_id': B1}` with the same claim.
  - Reviving B2 takes B3's slot through the `workswarm-never-opened:` witness. Dispatch to revived B1 lands on its generation 2 Session.
  - With every slot busy, both `create_bee` and `activate_bee` return CAPACITY_BUSY with their `bee_id`.
  - `WithoutHostRelease` builds the product without a Bee adapter. The eviction stays PENDING, and unknown and Beebou IDs are refused.
- **New `agent_bridge/tests/test_hive_slot_release.py`.** It covers the adapter witness: released proof stable across a restart, `STILL_IN_USE`/`UNKNOWN` give no proof, never-opened needs an intact mapping (damaged or missing file gives `UNKNOWN`), and an unknown `session.create` never counts as unopened. It also checks that the scope equals the `text_run` binding, and the settings and Host checks.
- `temp/hive-beebou/tests/test_beebou_selection.py`: `activate_bee` argument validation and the stable operation ID.

### Participants versus substitutes
| Role | In these tests |
|---|---|
| CLI assembly `configured_bridge`, Gateway WebSocket, Bridge start/stop | participant |
| Beebou Harness normal turn, Host tool guard, `HiveBeebouTools`, `BeeSelectionTools` | participant |
| Bot Repository, BotDirectory, SQLite Store writer (activation, slots, evictions) | participant |
| Bee `WorkSwarmAdapter` (mapping, `session.unload` path), `HiveSlotRelease` | participant |
| Model provider (loopback OpenAI-compatible endpoint) | substitute |
| WorkSwarm Gateway wire (`session.create` / `session.unload`; Bee turns held) | substitute |
| Bee completion verifier (configured, but no step reaches it) | substitute |

### Commands and results
Run on head (see below) in a Python 3.12 uv venv (`uv pip install -e . -e harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge -e harness/agent-core pytest pytest-asyncio ruamel.yaml`), with PYTHONPATH `tests/scenarios:harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src:harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests:<every temp/*/src>:temp/hive-worker/tests:harness/workswarm`.

```
# exit 0, 0 findings (189 of 434 files checked)
python3.13 -m unittest discover -s tests/architecture -p 'test_*.py'
# pre-merge head 3077a396: Ran 232 tests, OK (441 s). merged head a2dafabe: Ran 232 tests, OK (446 s)
pytest tests/scenarios/hive/test_phase2_*.py                     # 116 passed, 5 skipped (incl. 2 new)
pytest agent_bridge/tests/test_hive_*.py test_session_proximity_hive_*.py   # 78 passed, 2 skipped, 5 xfailed (incl. 6 new)
pytest agent_bridge/tests/test_workswarm_unload.py test_session_proximity_runtime_flow.py test_workswarm_adapter.py  # 100 passed
pytest temp/beebou/tests 142 · temp/hive-beebou/tests 6 · temp/hive-runtime/tests 25 · temp/hive-worker/tests 84
pytest temp/composio-mail 92 · temp/connection-foundation 69 (2 skipped) · temp/feishu-connector 4 · temp/report-goals 37
pytest temp/mail-signal-pipeline/tests   # 2 collection errors (ModuleNotFoundError test_mail_signals); same on base 440b12c5
```

G1's SC01 owner tests sit in `test_session_proximity_hive_{admission,answer,busy,migrations}` and `temp/hive-worker/tests`, all included above. A wheel built from this head contains `server_engine/hive_slot_release.{py,toml}` and `dm_hive_worker/directory/revival.py`.

Phase 2 C 线（#1309 Runtime/Host）第 1 项：产品启动在同一个 Registry 中并列登记 Beebou 与 WorkSwarm Bee Harness，Bee 轮只经该 Bee Session 已持久化的运行时绑定进入 WorkSwarm。

## 改动

- `HiveTurnStartup` 改用 `register_harnesses` 同时登记 `core/beebou/1`（身份与原来相同，已持久化的 Beebou 绑定不变）和 `core/workswarm/1`（`WorkSwarmBeeRuntime`）。WorkSwarm 条目在 Host 绑定其自有 Bee 传输之前 `ready() == False`。
- 新增 `dm_hive_runtime.assembly.bee_transport`：
  - `WorkSwarmBeeRuntime`：登记到 Registry 的 WorkSwarm Harness 入口，Host 启动前绑定一次 Bee 传输，并转发其进程生命周期（`start`/`stop`）。
  - `RegisteredBeeTransport`：Bee 调度器使用的 WorkSwarm 端口。每次 `open_scoped_session` 先核对 scope，再读该 Bee 的活跃绑定和 RUNNING 认领，读取 Store 中的运行时绑定（活跃代际首次运行时用 `commit_runtime_binding` 提交），经 `HiveProfileLoader.resolve` 解析到确切实现后才进入 WorkSwarm。

- `Bridge.configure_hive_bee_scheduler`：存在 `HiveTurnStartup` 时，把注入的 Bee 适配器绑定到登记的 WorkSwarm 条目，调度器改经 `RegisteredBeeTransport` 执行。
- `HiveBeeScheduler.run_once`：传输报告 WorkSwarm 当前不可准备时，不认领任何排队轮次，返回 `BeeRunResult('unavailable')`。
- 未改受限文件：`hive_bee_execution.py`、`hive_recovery_bootstrap.py`、Delivery、`providers.py`、Store 写入方与 Phase 1 代码均未改动。只调用了 Store 的公开读写（`read_bot_binding`、`hive_busy.read_running_turn`、`read_runtime_binding`、`commit_runtime_binding`）。

- 产品启动同时登记两个 Harness，WorkSwarm 未绑定前不可进入；
- Bee 轮经已提交的 `core/workswarm/1` 绑定运行，Store 中有 Beebou 与 Bee 两条运行时绑定；
- 重启后 WorkSwarm 身份变化：Bee 绑定返回显式不可用，Beebou 仍正常答复；
- 依赖被移除后调度器不认领 Bee 轮；
- 传输转发自有运行时的启动和停止。

在本分支与合并前的 H2 `305282dd` 上对比（`/workspace/runh2.sh` 同一命令）：见下方 HIVE PROGRESS 评论中的数字，没有新增失败。

## G3（本地，wheel 模式）

1441.author: huben0423-hw
1441.body:
## 摘要

Phase 2 C 线（#1309 Runtime/Host）第 2 项：提供真实的 Host 完成校验器，并让 `engine_cli serve --hive-results --hive-beebou-id <id> --hive-turns` 用它配置 Bee 调度器。

起点为 `origin/hive/hive2-integration` `305282dd`。PR base 是 main，只为跑 CI；不要合入 main，由集成 owner 按固定 head 合入 `hive/hive2-integration`。

解锁的 G3 行：**SC03-R1、SC03-D1**（`bee_completion_verifier`），连带 SC03-D2。R1 另需配套 PR hive2/workswarm-product-registration。

## 复用情况

- #1378 cli-assembly、#1379 bee-scheduler、#1389 scheduler-recovery 已在 H2 中，提供 `configured_bridge(bee_adapter=..., bee_verify_completion=...)` 注入点和调度器。本 PR 只补上缺的部分：真实校验器以及 `serve` 的接线。
- `hive2/bee-observation-composition` / `legacy-cli-assembly` / `bee-owned-runtime` 一线与 H2 冲突。它们的思路（把 completion 观测交给 Host、调度器管理 Bee 运行时生命周期、Gateway 转发 `memory.status`）在这里从 H2 重新实现，没有带入那一线的 identity resolver 改动。
- Gateway `memory.status` 转发补丁沿用 `1a2c0774` 的 `runtime_patches` 条目（before/after sha256 已对 vendored 源码核对）。

## 改动

- 新增 `dm_hive_runtime.assembly.bee_runtime.WorkSwarmCompletionVerifier`（`__call__` 用于新任务，`queued` 用于排队补充）。见证只来自 Bee 专用 WorkSwarm 运行时自己的记录：
  - 该 Bee Session 原始 chat 请求的 completion proof：`session.runtime_state`，要求同一 Session、request ID 与 runtime generation，`completion_proof_version == 1`，状态为 BUSY 时按 TOML 参数轮询到 COMPLETED；
  - Session 隔离事实：`persist_session=false`，`memory.status` 为 engine `none`、enabled 与 auto_memory 均为 false；
  - 观测前后 request ID 必须不变。
  
  答复文本只以 sha256 绑定进见证，不作证据。任何一项缺失、超时或不一致都返回空见证，认领保持未结算（`BeeExecutionBridge` 现有的失败即关闭语义）。校验器不打开 Session，也不发送输入。
- `WorkSwarmAdapter` 新增两个只读方法：`live_scoped_session(scope_id)`（只返回本进程已打开的 Session，从不创建）和 `observe_bee_isolation(session_id, mode, timeout)`。
- `engine_cli.hive_bee_options(workspace, environment)`：构建独立的 Bee 运行时适配器（launcher `--bee-runtime`，独立回环端口，私有配置与数据目录）和校验器。`serve` 只在选了 `--hive-turns` 时传给 `configured_bridge`；默认的 `serve` 不变。G3 步骤可以调用同一个函数。
- `HiveBeeScheduler`：负责启动和停止注入的自有 Bee 运行时。启动失败时 Bee 轮保持排队，下一轮重试，Beebou 不受影响。
- 可调参数放在 `dm_hive_runtime/config/bee_runtime.toml`（端口、轮询间隔、截止时间、RPC 超时），没有新增环境变量。
- 未改受限文件：`hive_bee_execution.py`、`hive_recovery_bootstrap.py`、Delivery、`providers.py`、Store 写入方与 Phase 1 代码均未改动。

## 测试

- `temp/hive-runtime/tests/test_hive_runtime_bee_completion.py`（15 个）：COMPLETED 且隔离时给出确定性的见证，并绑定 request 与文本；BUSY 时轮询；UNKNOWN/FAILED/STALE、超时、没有 live Session 或 request、共享记忆的 Session、未完成或不属于本认领、proof 不匹配、观测中 request 被替换，这些都不给见证；排队补充按 `source_seq` 区分；端口取自 TOML，并拒绝与 Personal Agent 端口冲突。
- `tests/test_hive_serve_bee_scheduler.py`（6 个）：`serve --hive-turns` 安装的是真实校验器和独立 Bee 适配器；默认 `serve` 不配置调度器；调度器启停自有运行时；启动失败时不认领并会重试；适配器只读观测隔离、不发送输入；Gateway 补丁可应用到 vendored 源码。
- 与 H2 `305282dd` 对比：见 HIVE PROGRESS 评论，没有新增失败。
- 架构检查（python3.13）：0 个问题。

## G3（本地，wheel 模式）

组合：H2 `305282dd` + #1424（`3148e9cb`）+ hive2/workswarm-product-registration + 本分支（两个 PR 合并时没有冲突），HIVE1-PKG-1 PASS。
- 仅在本地把 #1424 的 `cli_workswarm_registration` 和 `bee_completion_verifier`（`dm_hive_runtime.assembly.bee_runtime`：`WorkSwarmCompletionVerifier.queued`、`owned_bee_environment`）填上：3 PASS / 0 FAIL / 6 BLOCKED / 4 NOT_RUN。SC03-R1、R2、D1、D2 从 BLOCKED 变为 NOT_RUN，等 #1424 绑定组合步骤；其余行不变。

## 未做与限制

- 本机没有可运行的真实 WorkSwarm 运行时（缺 `ruamel` 等依赖），`WORKSWARM_RUNTIME_TESTS=1` 的真实运行时用例没有跑。校验器在真实运行时上的端到端证据需要在有运行时的环境中补（#1424 的 R1/D1 步骤）。
- `verify_resume_session` 仍未提供：重启后带排队补充的恢复保持 `unresolved`，这是现有的失败即关闭行为。

1442.author: Jianyu010
1442.body:
## Summary

Builds the two #1309 producer entries that block G3 (#1314) rows SC03-R1, R2, D1 and D2. Cut from `hive/hive2-integration` at `440b12c5`, then merged with integration `a6616d3d` (#1435, #1437, #1439); base `main`; lands only through `hive/hive2-integration` (#1421).

1. **`cli_workswarm_registration`.** `engine_cli serve --hive-results --hive-beebou-id <id> --hive-turns --hive-bees` (`configured_bridge(..., hive_bees=True)`) now:
   - starts an owned Bee-only WorkSwarm process (`--bee-runtime` launcher, `bee_ask_only=True`, its own loopback ports from TOML), separate from the Personal Agent runtime;
   - registers the exact WorkSwarm factory `ImplementationRef("core", "workswarm", "1")` and a runtime-owned model participant in the **same** v3.1 `RegistryProxy` as Beebou (`HiveTurnStartup.registry`);
   - before a Bee Session's first turn, commits the prepared `BindingSnapshot` through the Store's `commit_runtime_binding`; every turn resolves only that persisted binding and enters `WorkSwarmBeeHarness.run(identity, host)` with its own `RunOperations` + scoped `HostAPI`;
   - a missing or changed exact dependency returns an explicit `unavailable` result (`BeeRunResult.status == "unavailable"`), never a version switch; the claim stays unsettled.
   - Exact ref and instance are recorded on `Bridge.hive_bee_runtime` (`registration.reference`, `registration.factory`), in the Store binding row, and inside every witness digest.
2. **`bee_completion_verifier`.** `dm_hive_runtime.assembly.bee_verifier.HostBeeCompletionVerifier` returns a witness (`hive-bee-isolation-v1:<sha256>`) only when all hold for the exact lane:
   - the Host's own execution evidence exists (consumed once): HostAPI entered, sealed, closed, no pending or unknown operation;
   - the adapter is the owned, ready, ask-only Bee process (the ask-only rail refuses every non-`ask_user` tool at dispatch);
   - the stream's `session.runtime_state` proof (#1380/#1396/#1402) names the lane's actual Session and wire request in the current runtime generation, with proof version 1, and a fresh query still says COMPLETED;
   - the Store's RUNNING claim and ACTIVE binding are unchanged.

   `verify_queued_completion` applies the same checks to a queued supplement. `verify_resume_session` is true only while the runtime still holds the Session incarnation the last witness named. Missing, stale, failed or unknown evidence returns no witness. `Bridge.configure_hive_bee_runtime` configures the Bee scheduler with this verifier and the Host execution entry, so a Beebou dispatch reaches a committed Bee terminal and the SC03-D2 notice publisher (`Bridge._hive_result_publisher`) pushes it to the client.

Limits (also in `temp/hive-runtime/bee-runtime-observation.md`): the witness does not cover effects outside the runtime's tool dispatch (pre-existing processes, client-side actions). The evidence and witnessed Session are held in memory, so after a restart a witnessed head still commits but a queued supplement cannot resume (fails closed) until durable Host evidence exists (needs a #1311 Store write).

## Ported from huben0423-hw's drafts (cherry-picked with `-x`, authorship kept)

From #1401/#1414/#1417 (`hive2/legacy-cli-assembly` → `hive2/bee-runtime-lifecycle` → `hive2/bee-owned-runtime`), the commits not already on integration:

`cebf26fa` Resolve claimed Bee identity from scoped store binding · `f4792e5d` Connect Bee identity resolver to WorkSwarm turn · `8a7557d5` Verify scoped Bee identity against real Hive Store · `0744582d` Exercise Hive Bee identity through real runtime · `d28269a2` Isolate real runtime test collection · `979b7e33` Resolve Bee identity in production scheduler · `bba6e69f` Exercise scheduler with real Hive Store and runtime · `28d39eb6` Pass Bee runtime completion observation to Host verifier · `cbb39c5c` Forward explicit Bee dependencies through serve · `d1d0bb2b` Test Hive Bee reuse through the real serve listener · `90d7da55` Manage Bee runtime lifecycle through the Bridge (#1414) · `1a2c0774` Enable Bee memory preflight through owned WorkSwarm gateway (#1417).

`54e911fe` was skipped: integration already carries it as `f073eb93`. Conflicts were resolved against integration's SC03-D2 notice publisher and the `serve` early-spawn cleanup. #1409 (`fde6e528`, `7e31d44a`) and #1412 (`5e3f8dc3`) are already on integration and are used as-is (ask-only rail, resume correlation). #1415 (Worker follow-up port) was not needed: the existing `execute_bound_queued` covers the queued path here.

## Touches outside the new files (disclosed)

- `server_engine/server.py`: `configure_hive_bee_scheduler(..., run_turn=None)` pass-through, new `configure_hive_bee_runtime(workswarm)`, `self.hive_bee_runtime = None`, and the owned Bee runtime now stops in the backend shutdown phase. Scheduler/verifier lines only.
- Fix to the ported #1414 lifecycle: `HiveBeeScheduler.close()` only stops polling; the new `stop_runtime()` stops the owned process. Stopping a real process inside `close()` ran under the short producer deadline and failed shutdown ("Hive Bee scheduler shutdown exceeded its deadline").
- `server_engine/engine_cli.py`: `hive_bees` option in `configured_bridge` / `serve` and the `--hive-bees` flag.
- `server_engine/hive_turn_startup.py`: one line, `self.registry = registry`, so the Bee Harness registers in the same Registry. The quick-reply path is untouched.
- `server_engine/hive_bee_execution.py` / `hive_bee_scheduler.py` (#1223 Delivery / Host integration): optional `run_turn` port (not `execute`: the domain-writer check reads `self.execute(...)` as dynamic SQL) so a Host execution entry replaces the direct adapter call. Default behavior unchanged.
- HIVE1-owned `temp/hive-worker/ownership.json`: publishes `text_run.execute_bound_claim` / `execute_bound_queued` (added by the ported #1414 commits). `temp/hive-beebou/ownership.json`: `hive-bee-scheduler` may call `hive-bee-identity`.
- Untouched: `dm_hive_beebou/selection.py`, the Beebou quick-reply path, slot-release code.

## New files

- `temp/hive-runtime/src/dm_hive_runtime/assembly/bee_runtime.py`, `bee_verifier.py`, `config/bee_runtime.toml` (+ `load_bee_runtime`)
- `server_engine/hive_bee_runtime.py` (legacy composition; adapter row in `temp/hive-runtime/ownership.json`, with `hive_bee_identity.py`)
- `tests/scenarios/hive/test_phase2_bee_verifier.py` (real Store, Registry, HostAPI and adapter; controlled wire)
- `tests/scenarios/hive/test_phase2_cli_bee_runtime.py` (product entry, real owned runtime; `WORKSWARM_RUNTIME_TESTS=1`)

## Verification

Python 3.12 uv venv (`uv pip install -e . -e harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge -e harness/agent-core pytest pytest-asyncio ruamel.yaml`), the PYTHONPATH from the task, head `354a6312`.

| Check | Result |
| --- | --- |
| `tools/architecture/check.py --policy docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json --root .` | 0 findings (200 of 445 files checked). The ported commits alone had 11; fixed by the ownership rows |
| `tests/architecture` | 232 passed, 446 subtests |
| `test_phase2_*` + Bridge `test_hive_*`, no runtime | 184 passed, 11 skipped, 5 xfailed |
| Same, plus `test_workswarm_bee_identity`, with `WORKSWARM_RUNTIME_TESTS=1` on the pinned runtime | 198 passed, 5 xfailed, 0 skipped |
| Bridge `test_workswarm_*` | 228 passed, 9 skipped, 8 failed: all 8 in `test_workswarm_runtime_phase`, which fails on main too. One other test failed once while `tests/architecture` ran in parallel and did not reproduce in two reruns |
| `temp/*/tests` | beebou 142, composio-mail 92, connection-foundation 69 (2 skipped), feishu-connector 4, hive-beebou 12, hive-runtime 32, hive-worker 84, report-goals 37, all passed; mail-signal-pipeline 65 passed when run from its own directory, which it needs to collect |
| `git diff --check` | clean |

**Product-entry test** `test_phase2_cli_bee_runtime.py` (1 passed, 16 s, pinned runtime built by `harness/personal-agent/deploy/install_runtime.py` with the `session.unload.v1` patch): the real `configured_bridge(..., hive_bees=True)` assembly behind `create_app` on loopback, an authenticated `/digitalmate/ws` client sends `hive.message.send` → Beebou lists, creates and dispatches a Bee → the scheduler claims it → the WorkSwarm Harness resolved from the Registry runs it on a real owned Bee WorkSwarm process (own ports, ask-only) → the Host verifier issues the witness → the Store commits → the SC03-D2 notice publisher broadcasts → the client gets `digitalmate.task.text` (`final`, `event_id == committed_message_id`, text `12`). It also checks two runtime bindings (Beebou + Bee), the `hive-bee-isolation-v1:` witness on the Run, and that the runtime process stops at shutdown. **Substitutes:** the model behind both runtimes (a loopback OpenAI-compatible endpoint with scripted replies) and `ScriptedBackend` for non-Hive Engine turns.

`test_phase2_bee_verifier.py` (real Store, Registry, HostAPI and adapter; controlled wire and owned-process facts) covers: the exact ref, the factory instance and the scoped `HostAPI` entered; a stale runtime generation leaves the claim unsettled; missing, forged, replayed or non-ask-only evidence gives no witness; FAILED/BUSY/STALE/UNKNOWN proofs give no witness; a removed exact version gives `unavailable` with no rebinding; a queued supplement resumes only with the witnessed Session, and a fresh verifier (the state after a restart) fails closed.

**Not run:** the G3 runner itself (#1424). HIVE2 QA binds it with the rows below. Not covered: the R2 restart on a real install. Its lever: restart with a different `[registry] harness_version` in `bee_runtime.toml` (or patch `server_engine.hive_bee_runtime.load_bee_runtime`) after a Bee has run once. `HiveBeeScheduler.run_once()` then returns `BeeRunResult(status="unavailable")` for that Bee, the claim stays RUNNING, and Beebou `hive.message.send` still commits.

## Merged with integration a6616d3d

Conflicts resolved:
- `temp/hive-runtime/ownership.json`: union with #1437's exports.
- `engine_cli.configured_bridge`: kept #1439's `configure_hive_slot_release`. It now runs for any Bee adapter with `release_scoped_session`, so the `--hive-bees` owned adapter also gets the Host slot-release caller.

```toml
         "HostBeeCompletionVerifier.verify_resume_session"]
```

1443.author: huben0423-hw
1443.body:
D 线（#1310 Beebou）候选 PR，合并了 Beebou 工具门（取代 #1431）和快回 / 次快回准备（取代 #1432），并在 Beebou 实际调用路径上接通 Host grant。

**基线与依赖**
- 固定基线：`hive/hive2-integration@305282dd`（与当前 H2 `33e821c1`（#1438）无冲突，`git merge-tree` 干净，改动文件不重叠）（已含 #1429，也就是经 #1435 合入的 done→reply、`drain_inbox` 和过渡用的 `_BeeReportTurnTools`）。base 设为 main 只是为了跑 CI，请不要合进 main。集成 owner 按 pinned head 合进 H2。
- 依赖 H2 里已有的 #1377（终态和来源校验）、H-C7 `HiveReplyOrdering`（#1311）、`NativeBeebouRunner` 和 `BeebouToolGuard`（#1365）。没有改 Delivery 文件、Store writer 或 Phase 1 代码。

**做了什么**
1. 工具门（#1431 接入）。每次执行都由 Host 按阶段发放 `BeebouToolGrant`：
   - 快回：不开放任何工具，模型拿到的 `tools=()`，grant 为 QUICK，`tools.call` 全部拒绝。
   - 次快回准备：只开放 TOML 允许列表里、且由可信 provider 登记过的只读工具（`dm_hive_runtime/config/tools.toml`）。
   - 正常轮：开放 Bot 工具和允许列表内的只读工具。
   - Bee report 唤醒的轮次没有 authorizer，`create_bee`、`dispatch new/steer` 一律以工具结果的形式拒绝，取代 #1429 的 `_BeeReportTurnTools`。
   - 用户轮的 Bot 动作由 Host 逐次授权（`_UserActionAuthorizer`），检查四点：来源仍是这一轮已受理、未消费的用户输入，不是 Bot 数据；输入里确实带有指令；`source_ids` 只能引用这条输入，不认模型自己生成的 ID；steer 只能指向本 Beebou 派给该 Bee、仍处于 queued 或 running 的任务。
   - `BeebouToolGuard` 让只读工具直接通过，不预留 plan；未登记的工具仍然 fail closed。
2. 拒绝和故障分开处理。只有 grant 主动拒绝（`ToolNotGranted`）才转成模型能处理的工具结果。provider 或 Store 在 effect 之后抛出的异常原样上抛，plan 留给对账，不吞掉也不重试（有测试）。
3. 快回接入 H-C7。正常轮忙时受理的消息会：
   - `claim_quick_reply`，然后经 `QuickBeebouRunner`（v3.1 HostAPI，带 tools.call journal）生成快回，再 `commit_quick_reply`，提交后才推送 `hive.beebou.quick_reply`。
   - 次快回准备并行查只读工具，得到的材料只交给正常轮，自己不发布。
   - 正常轮先 `claim_normal_turn`，这会封口快回，并取回已发布的快回。已发布快回和仍有效的材料作为模型输入的 system 备注提供，不写进已提交的历史。如果正常轮的答复和快回相同，就不再发布。
   - 之后若又有新的用户输入（比如更正城市），旧材料不再提供，正常轮会重查或追问。
   - 设备显示通过 Gateway 方法 `hive.message.quick_displayed` 写入 `record_quick_displayed`。
   - 预算、超时和提示词都在 `dm_hive_beebou/config/quick.toml`（待定的产品值）。
4. done→reply 补测。基于 #1377 已有的终态和来源校验，在 #1429 已覆盖的用户消息优先、旧 Run、重复 drain、提交后回复之外，新增重复 done 上报和跨 scope done。

**G3 行（本地 checkout 模式，未跑 wheel 和 package proof）**
测试分支：本 PR 合入 #1424 `claude/hive2-g3-runner`，并在本地把 producers.toml 两行改成下面的值。
- 改动前：PASS 3（B1、B2、B7）。R3、B3–B6 为 BLOCKED（缺 `tool_provider` 和 `beebou_quick_reply`）。
- 改动后：PASS 3（B1、B2、B7）。R3、B3、B4、B5、B6 由 BLOCKED 变为 NOT_RUN（producer 已就位，等 QA 在 sc03_cli 绑定组合步骤）。FAIL 0。
- 建议集成 owner 在 #1424 填的行：
  - `[roles.beebou_quick_reply]` 填 `module = "dm_hive_beebou.harness.quick"`，`attrs = ["BeebouQuickReply.run", "BeebouQuickPreparation.run"]`。

  - 组合步骤可以照 `tests/test_hive_beebou_quick_reply.py` 的流程写：上一轮卡在受控工具上，M2 触发快回。

**真实与受控参与者**
- 真实：`configured_bridge`、Registry、SQLite Hive Store（受理、H-C7、Beebou context claim/commit、task view）、Host grant、BeebouToolGuard、HostAPI（RunOperations）、Delivery report、HiveBusy 终态提交。
- 受控（已标注）：模型输出、只读天气 provider、Bee runtime（induced 测试沿用 #1429 的受控 done）。

**测试（对比 H2@305282dd 基线，无新增失败）**

- induced：8 passed、7 xfailed。
- scenarios/hive：117 passed。

1451.author: Jianyu010
1451.body:
Project Hive Phase 2, gate G3 (HIVE-SC-03, RFC #1316), SC03-B8 under the decided **#1268 scheme two** (2026-11-14). An evicted Bee's ID is refused and never activated again; similar work gets a new `bee_id`, a new Session and its own Local Memory, and may reference the old profile.

**Cut from `hive/hive2-integration` @ `759a77aa`**, which already carries #1450 (Store default `retire_evicted_identity = true`). Base stays `main`, and this lands **through `hive/hive2-integration`**. Do not merge it to `main` directly. It does not depend on #1449.

This PR adds only one product-entry test file. It changes no product code, no Delivery result or terminal path, and no Host slot release (#1439).

## What the new test covers
`tests/scenarios/hive/test_phase2_bee_eviction.py::EvictedIdentityJourney::test_evicted_id_is_refused_and_similar_work_gets_a_new_bee` runs over the real CLI assembly: `configured_bridge(..., hive_turns=True, bee_adapter=WorkSwarmAdapter, ...)`, Gateway `hive.message.send` and Beebou normal turns with a controlled model.

- **Eviction.** It fills all 4 slots with idle Bees and creates one more. The Host proves the LRU Bee B1's release through `session.unload`, the Store records `workswarm-released:`, and B1 is ARCHIVED.
- **Old ID refused.** `activate_bee(B1)` returns `{'status': 'RETIRED', 'bee_id': B1}`. A replay of the same operation ID returns the same receipt and creates no claim or eviction. B1 is listed only under `profile_references`.
- **Similar work.** `create_bee` with B1's profile and `reference_bee_id=B1` registers a new ID N1.
  - The next victim B2's runtime reports `STILL_IN_USE`, so N1 is `{'status': 'PENDING', 'bee_id': N1}`. The eviction stays CLAIMED, B2 stays EVICTING, the slot stays RELEASING and N1 has no binding.
  - A replay keeps the same `bee_id` and claim.
  - Once the runtime releases B2, the Host's recovery pass confirms it. N1 becomes ACTIVE at generation 1 on a new Session, with the same profile as B1 and its own WorkSwarm runtime session (not B1's). A replay returns ACTIVE with the same claim.
- **Never-opened witness.** Similar work for B2 takes B3's slot through the `workswarm-never-opened:` witness.
- **Dispatch.** The new Bee takes work on its own Session. Evicted IDs never appear as active targets.
- **All slots busy.**
  - `create_bee` returns CAPACITY_BUSY with its `bee_id`, and the definition stays REGISTERED.
  - `activate_bee` of that kept, never-started Bee returns CAPACITY_BUSY with its `bee_id`.
  - `activate_bee` of an evicted ID stays RETIRED.

`test_phase2_bee_revive.py` (#1439, adjusted by #1450) keeps the H-D2 opt-out (`ReviveJourney`, `RETIRE_EVICTED_IDENTITY = False`) and the product without a Bee adapter (`WithoutHostRelease`). #1449 adds restart and Phase 1 rollback cases on top.

### Participants versus substitutes
| Role | In this test |
|---|---|
| CLI assembly, Gateway WebSocket, Bridge start/stop, Store setting from #1450 | participant |
| Beebou Harness normal turn, Host tool guard, `HiveBeebouTools` / `BeeSelectionTools` | participant |
| Bot Repository, BotDirectory, SQLite Store writer (activation, retirement, slots, evictions) | participant |
| Bee `WorkSwarmAdapter`, `HiveSlotRelease` | participant |
| Model provider (loopback OpenAI-compatible endpoint) | substitute |
| WorkSwarm Gateway wire (`session.create` / `session.unload`; Bee turns held) | substitute |
| Bee completion verifier (configured, not reached) | substitute |

## Commands and results
